items.rationale: Recognizable filling and bread create a sandwich; reuses a previously terminal omelette. No new tool, concept or preparation ambiguity beyond the already established game abstraction.

Boiled egg is a familiar potato-salad ingredient. The explanation explicitly cooks and cools the potato; the game uses the same implicit preparation convention as existing potato recipes. Reuses a terminal discovery with an existing result.

Cooked potato flesh can be mashed with butter. The explanation explicitly removes skin and mashes rather than merely adding a topping; rewards the already prepared potato. This is a plausible alternative recipe, not an exclusive two-ingredient cooking claim.
